title: HD player body: Orc female (model, textures, faces, hair, skin colors)
description: Replaces the Orc female player model (display 52) with a community HD body via private CreatureModelData row 2369, plus CharSections rows for every skin/face/hair/facial-hair/underwear variation. Built by tools/characters/build_characters.py into mod-source/characters-hd (shared patch-0 payload with the other 15 bodies).
